notes: Rolling grassland — the M1 hub surface. ART_BIBLE 4, Meadow / hub. Saturation corrected: lit must sit BELOW shadow in chroma (measured -0.15 across references); the earlier ART_BIBLE rule had this inverted. M4: `deform` opts this surface into the deformation field. ART_BIBLE 4 gives the meadow shallow ruts that spring back over ~20s with mud only under hard cornering, and those rates live in src/deform/biome.ts. The ground mesh is 19 m quads, so ALL of the visible mark here comes from the FRAGMENT normal and the albedo blend rather than from displaced vertices — `deformNormal` is the knob for that. `deformRelief` is therefore 0, and that is a compile-time zero: painterly.ts emits no `positionNode` at all for this surface, so the one 177k-vertex mesh in the build stops paying ten vertex-stage texture fetches per vertex for a displacement that cannot resolve on a 19 m quad. M2's CDLOD terrain is what earns it back — turn it on with the tessellation, not before.
